sections.Profile:
Drained: Bite-Sized, released by For Amusement Only Games in October 2023, is a speedrunning, multiball challenge designed for the Multimorphic P3 platform. This game requires the Drained playfield module to play.

- Manufacturer: For Amusement Only
- Years made: 2023
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, 2020s, Original Theme, Mini-Game, Solid State, Module Game, Horror
